policy: Deterministic budgets from the production build manifests, checked in CI by scripts/check-budgets.mjs (npm run budgets): no browser, no timing, no network.
The budget build uses placeholder public Supabase env (NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=https://placeholder.supabase.co and a dummy publishable key) so the bundle is production-shaped.
Startup JS is rootMainFiles without polyfillFiles plus the entryJSFiles of the route page client reference manifest; startup CSS is its entryCSSFiles; both are re-gzipped at level 9.
Fonts are the first url() source of every @font-face rule in the startup CSS whose unicode-range covers the Vietnamese or English message text.
Ceilings were recorded with node scripts/check-budgets.mjs --record: the measured value plus 4 percent, rounded up to the next KiB; counts carry no headroom.

A ceiling may only rise in a commit whose message states the metric, its old and new value and timed-gate evidence (the p95 report of scripts/perf/run.mjs), and the rise must be approved in the pull request.
limits are product rules from CLAUDE.md: graphics JS (three.js, GSAP, garden worker and scenes) at most 220 KiB gzip and every mobile poster at most 80 KiB.
ratchetModules lists forbidden startup modules that still ship on a route today; an entry may only be removed, and the check fails once its module no longer ships there so the removal is committed.
Catalogue-dependent bytes (artwork images, HTML) are reported in artifacts/budget-report.json and never gated.
